goal: Stop a lagging post-deletion readback of the reviewer mutex reporting a SUCCESSFUL reviewer draw as RECOVERY REQUIRED and discarding its result (issues 2457 and 2844, one root cause).
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues in this repository to production
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not widen REVIEW_OPERATION_REQUEST_LIMIT or any derived request ceiling.
Do not remove the RECOVERY REQUIRED refusal; an orphaned mutex is never assumed released.
Do not hand-delete any refs/db-review-active or refs/db-coordination ref.
assumptions: The accepted atomic compare-and-swap deletion is authoritative; the git replica read that follows it can lag and is corroboration only.
Issues 2457 and 2844 are one defect and are resolved by one change.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would require widening a derived request ceiling.
Stop if the fix would require removing or weakening the mutex-release refusal.
